digest.component_or_area: Quality audit remediation (CI, docs, file size/complexity/typing ratchets)
propositions: CI test flake in Python 3.11 xdist worker during test_opcert_service_app caused by pytest-xdist teardown race under load contention, not application code
User-facing assignee documentation example teaches Jira-unresolvable identity inconsistent with docs/config.md
Near-cap modules (structured_run.py, compact.py, event_append.py) mix responsibilities across layers causing file-size violations and duplicated infrastructure
Graph loader/traversal functions exhibit high cyclomatic complexity (CCN) due to duplicated BFS and state-loading logic repeated across _blockers and _compute_dep_graph call sites
attest package fails mypy type checking under --disallow-untyped-defs constraint
Module splits and complexity reductions must preserve public import paths and be executed against non-contended files to avoid conflicts with in-progress work
